text.tspan: The Adafruit NeoKey CHOC breakout board has everything on it that the Glove80 uses for its keys. Each white box in the PCB diagrams
represents an individual, upside down Adafruit board. Keys attach to the opposite side of the illustration (side not shown). Adafruit has
publically published the schematics for its NeoKey board. They can be found online for further detail.
